alloc.rule: base weights by regime — equity / metals / bonds / cash: Goldilocks 70/10/15/5, Reflation 65/15/5/15, Stagflation 35/30/10/25, Disinflation 55/10/30/5 — blended by the nowcast's regime probabilities (so the book never jumps on a label change); the gate moves ten points from equity to cash. Half the equity is the core (Nifty 50 and Next 50); half goes to three sleeves the regime favours that are also trending — never to an UNDERWEIGHT. Gold is the metal sleeve (silver joins when it trends). Long gilts in Disinflation and Goldilocks, short gilts otherwise, halved when gilts trend down. Cash is the residual.
alloc.how: each sleeve is measured on its long index in rupees since 2015 (the ETF is what you trade), labelled week by week with the same CPI × IIP regime path the rest of the page uses; the number is the average forward 13-week return in that regime and the share of weeks that paid. Windows overlap, so n counts weeks, not independent quarters. Trend is the ETF against its 40-week average and its 13-week return; the word needs the trend, and the regime's record may confirm or veto it. A map of what each regime has paid — not a forecast, not a backtest of the allocation.

pairs.how: two F&O names in one sector whose daily returns correlate ≥ 0.6 over a year; the spread is log(A) − β·log(B), β by least squares over 250 sessions; an idea when the spread sits ≥ 2σ from its 60-session mean and mean-reverts with a half-life of 3–40 sessions. Long the cheap leg, short the rich one in rupee-balanced lots; target the mean, stop at 3σ (or 0.75σ further out), horizon twice the half-life. Never against the engine's own side on either leg.

nowcast.how: the official CPI and IIP are the anchor; the market's thirteen-week impulses (z-scored since 2015) nudge them — one σ of inflation impulse = 0.4 CPI points, one σ of growth impulse = 1.2 IIP points over the quarter; the quadrant lines (CPI 4, IIP 3) become probabilities through a logistic with the series' own noise (0.5 and 1.0 points). The label on the page stays the official one; the probabilities are the market's lean, and the model book blends its base weights by them.
nowcast.source: MACRO_LIVE · the sleeves panel (twelve years weekly)

method.short: 0.40 trend (risk-adjusted 20/60-session momentum, the 50-day, the 52-week position, −extension) + 0.22 macro (the wind, the sector's regime edge × its t, sector RS) + 0.13 futures flow + 0.15 the contenders + 0.10 quality; percentile-ranked; BUY ≥ 80, SELL ≤ 10 (F&O only); stop 1.5 × 5-day σ (4–14%), target 2R, horizon 5–60 sessions by volatility, size = 1% of capital / stop (halved when the gate is on)
method.long: 0.35 trend (120/250-session momentum, the 200-day) + 0.25 macro (the sector's regime edge, sector RS, the name's own regime record) + 0.30 quality (ROE, margins, growth, debt, P/E vs sector, P/B, promoter) + 0.10 drawdown; ACCUMULATE ≥ 80, AVOID ≤ 20; the stop is the 200-day; the 12-month target = shrunk momentum + the sector's regime edge + a quality tilt, with a ±1σ band
method.intraday: the names in play: yesterday's move in σ units, turnover, the futures lean, the contenders' p(move); a side only when the lean is clear; entry zone, stop 0.9σ, target 1.6σ, flat by 15:20
